//! Asset-free Polaris pixel star and shared header geometry.
use crate::{
    app::App,
    theme::{Theme, ThemeMode},
};
use ratatui::{
    Frame,
    buffer::Cell,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier},
};
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Variant {
    Welcome,
    Compact,
    Emblem,
}
impl Variant {
    fn size(self) -> (u16, u16) {
        match self {
            Self::Welcome => (15, 7),
            Self::Compact => (11, 5),
            Self::Emblem => (11, 1),
        }
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct HeaderLayout {
    pub variant: Variant,
    pub logo: Rect,
    pub metadata: Rect,
    pub history_y: u16,
}

/// body_height excludes the composer and footer, but includes the top margin.
pub(crate) fn layout(app: &App, area: Rect, body_height: u16) -> HeaderLayout {
    // Popups keep the underlying star; the emblem is only an extreme height fallback.
    let variant = if body_height < 7 {
        Variant::Emblem
    } else if !app.entries.is_empty() || app.working || body_height < 11 {
        Variant::Compact
    } else {
        Variant::Welcome
    };
    let (width, height) = variant.size();
    let header_height = height.max(4);
    let (x, y) = (area.x.saturating_add(2), area.y.saturating_add(2));
    let text_x = x + width + 3;
    HeaderLayout {
        variant,
        logo: Rect::new(x, y, width, height),
        metadata: Rect::new(
            text_x,
            y + (header_height - 4) / 2,
            area.right().saturating_sub(2).saturating_sub(text_x),
            4,
        ),
        history_y: y + header_height + 1,
    }
}

// Two vertical pixels per terminal cell keep the star close to square.
// G = green body; M = mint facet; . = transparent canvas.
const WELCOME: [&str; 14] = [
    ".......GG......",
    ".......GG......",
    "......GGM......",
    "......GGM......",
    ".....GGGMM.....",
    "GGGGGGGGGMMMMMM",
    ".GGGGGGGGGGGGG.",
    "..GGGGGGGGGGG..",
    "...GGGGGGGGG...",
    "....GGGGGGM....",
    "...GGGGGGGMM...",
    "...GGG..GGGM...",
    "..GGG....GGGM..",
    "..GG......GGG..",
];
const COMPACT: [&str; 10] = [
    ".....GG....",
    ".....GM....",
    "....GGMM...",
    "GGGGGGGMMMM",
    ".GGGGGGGGG.",
    "..GGGGGGG..",
    "...GGGGGM..",
    "..GGGGGMM..",
    "..GGG.GGM..",
    ".GGG...GGG.",
];
const ASCII_WELCOME: [&str; 7] = [
    "       *       ",
    "      ***      ",
    "***************",
    "  ***********  ",
    "    *******    ",
    "   **** ****   ",
    "  ***     ***  ",
];
const ASCII_COMPACT: [&str; 5] = [
    "     *     ",
    "***********",
    "  *******  ",
    "   *****   ",
    "  **   **  ",
];
const EMBLEM: &str = "     *     ";
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Pixel {
    Empty,
    Body,
    Highlight,
}
fn pixels(variant: Variant) -> Vec<Vec<Pixel>> {
    let rows: &[&str] = match variant {
        Variant::Welcome => &WELCOME,
        Variant::Compact => &COMPACT,
        Variant::Emblem => &[],
    };
    rows.iter()
        .map(|row| {
            row.bytes()
                .map(|c| match c {
                    b'G' => Pixel::Body,
                    b'M' => Pixel::Highlight,
                    _ => Pixel::Empty,
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .collect()
}
fn color(theme: Theme, pixel: Pixel) -> Color {
    if !theme.color {
        return Color::Reset;
    }
    if theme.rgb && theme.mode == ThemeMode::Dark {
        match pixel {
            Pixel::Body => Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70),
            Pixel::Highlight => Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172),
            Pixel::Empty => Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0),
        }
    } else {
        match pixel {
            Pixel::Body => Color::Green,
            Pixel::Highlight => Color::LightGreen,
            Pixel::Empty => Color::Reset,
        }
    }
}
fn canvas(theme: Theme) -> Color {
    if !theme.color || theme.mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
        Color::Reset
    } else if theme.rgb {
        Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0)
    } else {
        Color::Black
    }
}
fn cell(top: Pixel, bottom: Pixel, theme: Theme) -> Cell {
    let mut result = Cell::default();
    result
        .set_style(theme.base().remove_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))
        .set_bg(canvas(theme));
    let (glyph, fg, bg) = match (top, bottom) {
        (Pixel::Empty, Pixel::Empty) => (' ', Color::Reset, canvas(theme)),
        (p, Pixel::Empty) => ('▀', color(theme, p), canvas(theme)),
        (Pixel::Empty, p) => ('▄', color(theme, p), canvas(theme)),
        (a, b) if a == b => ('█', color(theme, a), canvas(theme)),
        (a, b) if theme.color && theme.mode == ThemeMode::Dark => {
            ('▀', color(theme, a), color(theme, b))
        }
        // Inherited/monochrome modes keep both pixels occupied without forcing a background.
        _ => ('█', color(theme, Pixel::Highlight), canvas(theme)),
    };
    result.set_char(glyph).set_fg(fg).set_bg(bg);
    result
}
fn ascii_rows(variant: Variant) -> &'static [&'static str] {
    match variant {
        Variant::Welcome => &ASCII_WELCOME,
        Variant::Compact => &ASCII_COMPACT,
        Variant::Emblem => &[EMBLEM],
    }
}
pub(crate) fn render(frame: &mut Frame, rect: Rect, variant: Variant, theme: Theme, ascii: bool) {
    let visible = rect.intersection(frame.area());
    if visible.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let image = pixels(variant);
    for y in visible.y..visible.bottom() {
        for x in visible.x..visible.right() {
            let (col, row) = ((x - rect.x) as usize, (y - rect.y) as usize);
            frame.buffer_mut()[(x, y)] = if ascii || variant == Variant::Emblem {
                let glyph = ascii_rows(variant)[row].as_bytes()[col] as char;
                let mut c = Cell::default();
                c.set_style(theme.base().remove_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))
                    .set_char(glyph)
                    .set_fg(if glyph == '*' {
                        color(theme, Pixel::Body)
                    } else {
                        Color::Reset
                    })
                    .set_bg(canvas(theme));
                c
            } else {
                cell(image[row * 2][col], image[row * 2 + 1][col], theme)
            };
        }
    }
}
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::app::{Entry, EntryKind};
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;
    #[test]
    fn header_balances_welcome_and_tracks_session_and_available_body_height() {
        let mut app = App::default();
        for (w, h) in [(120, 40), (100, 30), (80, 24), (60, 20)] {
            assert_eq!(
                layout(&app, Rect::new(0, 0, w, h), h - 4).variant,
                Variant::Welcome
            );
        }
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 60, 20);
        app.input.set("Typing retains the welcome star");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 11).variant, Variant::Welcome);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 10).variant, Variant::Compact);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 8).history_y, 8);
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 6).variant, Variant::Emblem);
        app.entries
            .push(Entry::new(EntryKind::User, "", &["hello"]));
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/model");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Compact);
        app.command("/clear");
        assert_eq!(layout(&app, area, 16).variant, Variant::Welcome);
    }
    #[test]
    fn pixel_masks_have_five_tips_a_center_notch_and_one_connected_silhouette() {
        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact] {
            let image = pixels(variant);
            let (w, h) = variant.size();
            assert_eq!(image.len(), h as usize * 2);
            assert!(image.iter().all(|row| row.len() == w as usize));
            let mut unseen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
            for (y, row) in image.iter().enumerate() {
                for (x, p) in row.iter().enumerate() {
                    if *p != Pixel::Empty {
                        unseen.insert((x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            let mut pending = vec![*unseen.first().unwrap()];
            while let Some((x, y)) = pending.pop() {
                if !unseen.remove(&(x, y)) {
                    continue;
                }
                for next in [
                    (x.wrapping_sub(1), y),
                    (x + 1, y),
                    (x, y.wrapping_sub(1)),
                    (x, y + 1),
                ] {
                    if unseen.contains(&next) {
                        pending.push(next);
                    }
                }
            }
            assert!(unseen.is_empty());
            assert!(image.iter().flatten().any(|p| *p == Pixel::Highlight));
            assert_eq!(image[0][w as usize / 2], Pixel::Body);
            assert_eq!(image.last().unwrap()[w as usize / 2], Pixel::Empty);
        }
        let w = pixels(Variant::Welcome);
        for (x, y) in [(7, 0), (0, 5), (14, 5), (2, 13), (12, 13)] {
            assert_ne!(w[y][x], Pixel::Empty);
        }
        assert_eq!(w[13][7], Pixel::Empty);
        let c = pixels(Variant::Compact);
        for (x, y) in [(5, 0), (0, 3), (10, 3), (1, 9), (9, 9)] {
            assert_ne!(c[y][x], Pixel::Empty);
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn pixel_cells_preserve_width_palette_silhouette_and_color_fallbacks() {
        for color_enabled in [true, false] {
            for rgb in [true, false] {
                for mode in [ThemeMode::Dark, ThemeMode::Terminal] {
                    let theme = Theme {
                        color: color_enabled,
                        rgb,
                        mode,
                    };
                    for top in [Pixel::Empty, Pixel::Body, Pixel::Highlight] {
                        for bottom in [Pixel::Empty, Pixel::Body, Pixel::Highlight] {
                            let c = cell(top, bottom, theme);
                            assert_eq!(UnicodeWidthStr::width(c.symbol()), 1);
                            assert!(!c.modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD));
                            assert_eq!(
                                c.symbol() == " ",
                                top == Pixel::Empty && bottom == Pixel::Empty
                            );
                            if !color_enabled {
                                assert_eq!(c.fg, Color::Reset);
                                assert_eq!(c.bg, Color::Reset);
                            }
                            if mode == ThemeMode::Terminal {
                                assert_eq!(c.bg, Color::Reset);
                            }
                            if !rgb {
                                assert!(!matches!(c.fg, Color::Rgb(..)));
                                assert!(!matches!(c.bg, Color::Rgb(..)));
                            }
                            if bottom == Pixel::Empty {
                                assert_eq!(c.bg, canvas(theme));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let theme = Theme::default();
        assert_eq!(color(theme, Pixel::Body), Color::Rgb(36, 208, 70));
        assert_eq!(color(theme, Pixel::Highlight), Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172));
        let facet = cell(Pixel::Body, Pixel::Highlight, theme);
        assert_eq!(facet.symbol(), "▀");
        assert_eq!(facet.bg, Color::Rgb(150, 214, 172));
    }
    #[test]
    fn ascii_masks_and_emblem_have_exact_fixed_footprints() {
        for variant in [Variant::Welcome, Variant::Compact, Variant::Emblem] {
            let (w, h) = variant.size();
            let rows = ascii_rows(variant);
            assert_eq!(rows.len(), h as usize);
            assert!(rows.iter().all(|r| r.len() == w as usize && r.is_ascii()));
            assert!(
                rows.iter()
                    .flat_map(|r| r.chars())
                    .all(|c| c == ' ' || c == '*')
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(ascii_rows(Variant::Emblem), &["     *     "]);
    }
}
